claim: How a character leaves, which decides whether the shot ends on a person or on the space they vacated. A director reaches for left_behind when the departure is the other character's scene, not the leaver's.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: walking, leaving frame at the left edge, facing left, cropped
walking, leaving frame at the right edge, facing right, cropped
walking away, receding into the background, small distant figure
dropping below the frame, crouching out of view, only head at bottom edge
2boys, one walking away into the distance, one standing still watching
